reason.instructions: Why is the shopper returning the item? Pick the single category that best matches the shopper's answer.

criteria.fit_too_small: The item is too small or too tight: too tight in the shoulders, sleeves too short, cannot button or zip, runs small.
criteria.fit_too_large: The item is too big or too loose: swims on the shopper, falls off, runs large.
criteria.damaged_or_defective: The item arrived broken, damaged, cracked, torn, or does not work.
criteria.not_arrived: The item never arrived, was lost in shipping, or delivery failed.
criteria.changed_mind: The shopper changed their mind, no longer wants the item, or gives no product fault.
criteria.unclear: The answer gives no usable reason, or is vague, ambiguous, or off-topic, so the agent must ask again.
